newsitem.title: FRANCE: PRESS DIGEST - France - Le Monde March 26.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - France - Le Monde March 26.

text.p: These are leading stories in afternoon daily Le Monde.
-- Eastern city of Strasbourg expects demonstrations Saturday against a planned National Front far-right party congress.
-- Credit Agricole CNCP.PA posts a 7.5 billion franc profit for 1996, the highest among French companies, up 15.7 percent from 1995.
-- NetHold to post counter-performance in Scandinavia and Belgium, which may weigh on results of new unit expected to be formed with Canal Plus, to be announced officially on March 28.
-- Insurers may be pushed by an Axa-UAP merger, implemented three months ago, to unveil their strategy and planned alliances : AGF, Allianz, Generali and ING may be interested in GAN.
-- Elf-Atochem to invest some 1.15 billion francs with Nippon Shokubai in a chemicals plant in the United States.
-- Arms manufacturer GIAT Industries to sign on Thursday an agreement with Germany's Krauss Maffei KMAG.F and Britain's GKN on co-operation to build a European armed vehicle.
